summary: Apply Beztack template v1.2.0 onto Derived project dp_01HMV... (Trusted). Updates apps/api/products.ts with the product-module-registration seam preserved, updates apps/api/routes.ts with the api-route-registration and product-route-registration seams preserved (issue #35), refreshes the Environment contract with WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET, and renders Template parameters into package.json. One Sync conflict (apps/api/middleware.ts) requires an explicit decision: the file has no Sync seam registered in v1.1.0, so registering a seam is the right fix instead of marking the file Custom-owned. Two ownership overlaps (packages/auth/session.ts, apps/checkout/payment-handler.ts) are reported as warnings and resolved by the more-specific rule. The pnpm-lock.yaml lockfile is preserved as Custom-owned and is regenerated locally by the Derived project's package manager after the apply branch is prepared; engines must not copy a lockfile from the Template source. Template migrations are surfaced as separate steps: marker-environments-contract-v1.2.0 is already-applied (engine surfaces only), rotate-webhook-signing-secret is pending and requires manual human execution on the apply branch (interactive + destructive), and register-trusted-only-secrets-bundle is pending and requires manual execution (Trusted trust class). The engine does not execute any migration; the apply branch's MIGRATIONS.md documents each step for the reviewer.

trust.note: Derived project ID dp_01HMVBEZTACK0000000000000A is on the Beztack-owned registry; trust class is trusted.

conflicts.detail: Template source v1.2.0 introduces a default middleware on a Mixed-ownership path; the Derived project already has its own implementation and no Sync seam is registered for this file. Apply does not silently merge. Issue #35 documents this as the negative case that motivates the new product-module-registration seam on apps/api/products.ts: the right fix is to register an explicit seam so Derived projects can extend the framework, not to mark apps/api/middleware.ts Custom-owned to hide the drift.

migrations.description: Create the .beztack/migrations/v1.2.0-applied marker file so future sync runs can detect that this Derived project already accepted the v1.2.0 Environment contract.
migrations.note: Marker-file migration. Safe and reversible (delete the file to 'unapply'). The engine surfaces it for review but does not run it.

migrations.description: Rotate the WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET environment variable and re-register the new value with the upstream payment provider. Requires interactive confirmation because the rotation invalidates in-flight webhook deliveries.
migrations.note: Interactive migration: forces 'manual' execution regardless of trust class. Engine surfaces this as a manual step in status and apply output.

migrations.description: Publish the v1.2.0 secrets bundle to the Trusted Derived project registry so Beztack-owned pipelines can pick it up automatically. Community Derived projects do not get this bundle and must vendor the secrets manually.
migrations.note: Trusted-only migration. Community Derived projects must not run this; the engine surfaces it as 'manual-execution-required' and notes the trust restriction.
